runs.title: Webhook delivery stopped after retries
runs.label: sample ticket
runs.ticket: Our webhook endpoint returned 503. RelayNest has stopped retrying delivery. How can we recover it?

evidence.title: Webhook retry schedule
evidence.heading: Delivery recovery
evidence.body: RelayNest retries failed webhooks after 1 minute, 5 minutes, 30 minutes, and 2 hours. A delivery that still fails is marked exhausted. Fix the receiving endpoint, then choose Replay delivery in the delivery log. Replay creates a new delivery attempt with the original event ID. Receivers must deduplicate by event ID.

evidence.title: Event ordering and duplicates
evidence.heading: Delivery semantics
evidence.body: RelayNest does not guarantee webhook event order. Every event includes an event ID and an occurred_at timestamp. Store processed event IDs and make duplicate event handling idempotent. Do not infer state solely from delivery arrival order.

evidence.title: Webhook timeout handling
evidence.heading: Response deadline
evidence.body: The receiving endpoint must acknowledge a delivery with a 2xx response within ten seconds. Process long-running work after acknowledgment. A timeout is recorded as a failed delivery and follows the standard webhook retry schedule.

evidence.title: Event retention
evidence.heading: Retention window
evidence.body: RelayNest retains events for 30 days in the standard workspace. Export retention is seven days and is independent of event retention. Once events age out, generating a new export cannot recover them.

claims.text: To recover a delivery that has been marked exhausted, you must first fix the receiving endpoint and then select Replay delivery in the delivery log.

citations.quote: Fix the receiving endpoint, then choose Replay delivery in the delivery log.

answer.proposed_note: To recover a failed webhook marked as exhausted, the user must fix their endpoint and use the 'Replay delivery' option in the delivery log.

runs.title: API requests fail with an expired credential
runs.label: sample ticket
runs.ticket: Our integration returns 401 with credential_expired. How should we rotate the API credential safely?

evidence.title: Rotate an expired API credential
evidence.heading: Safe rotation
evidence.body: A 401 response with credential_expired means the API credential has reached its expiry date. Create a replacement credential in Settings > API credentials, update the integration secret, and verify a successful request. Revoke the old credential after verification. Never paste credentials into a support ticket.

evidence.title: API credential permissions
evidence.heading: Least privilege
evidence.body: Credentials can have read-events, write-events, or export permissions. A 403 response means the credential lacks the required permission. Workspace owners may create a replacement with the needed scope. An expired credential instead produces 401.

evidence.title: Credential lifetime
evidence.heading: Expiry policy
evidence.body: New RelayNest API credentials expire after 90 days. The owner can select an earlier expiry during creation. Existing credentials cannot have their expiry extended. A replacement is required. Expiry is evaluated in UTC.

evidence.title: Support action boundaries
evidence.heading: Internal notes
evidence.body: Support may recommend configuration changes and write internal ticket notes. A note does not perform the recommended change. The customer or an authorized workspace owner must rotate credentials, replay deliveries, or request exports in RelayNest.

claims.text: To rotate an expired API credential, create a replacement in Settings > API credentials, update the integration secret, and verify a successful request.

citations.quote: Create a replacement credential in Settings > API credentials, update the integration secret, and verify a successful request.

answer.proposed_note: The user should create a replacement credential in Settings, update the integration secret, verify the request, and then revoke the old credential.

runs.title: Export download link has expired
runs.label: sample ticket
runs.ticket: The CSV export completed yesterday, but the download now says link_expired. What should we do?

evidence.title: Expired export links
evidence.heading: Download recovery
evidence.body: CSV export download links expire 24 hours after completion. Open Exports, select the completed export, and choose Generate download link to obtain a fresh link. The underlying export is retained for seven days. After seven days, request a new export.

evidence.title: Failed export jobs
evidence.heading: Recovery steps
evidence.body: An export with status failed does not have a downloadable file. Read the failure code in the export detail view. For temporary_processing_error, create a new export with the same filters once. If the failure repeats, contact support with the job ID.

evidence.title: Export size limits
evidence.heading: Splitting exports
evidence.body: An export contains at most 100000 events. If the job reports result_too_large, split the requested time interval into smaller ranges. Completed exports remain available for seven days. The interface reports job status separately from download-link status.

evidence.title: CSV export format
evidence.heading: Encoding and timestamps
evidence.body: RelayNest exports UTF-8 CSV with a header row. Event times use ISO 8601 in UTC. Spreadsheet applications may display timestamps in a local time zone. The event_id column is stable across repeat exports.

claims.text: CSV export download links expire 24 hours after completion.

citations.quote: CSV export download links expire 24 hours after completion.

answer.proposed_note: The user's link expired because they completed the export yesterday (over 24 hours ago). They should go to Open Exports, select the completed export, and choose 'Generate download link' to get a fresh one.

runs.title: Türkçe destek talebi (Fatura Bulutu, eğitimde görülmedi)
runs.label: held-out Turkish product
runs.ticket: Profesyonel paket kullanıcısıyız ancak toplu fatura gönderimlerinde sistem çok yavaşladı ve faturalar beklemeye başladı.
runs.question: Paketinizdeki saniyelik gönderim limitini biliyor musunuz?

evidence.title: e-Fatura Gönderim Hızı ve Paket Limitleri (Güncel Sistem)
evidence.heading: Paket Bazlı Hız ve Kota Detayları
evidence.body: Yeni düzenlemeyle birlikte, Standart paket kullanıcılarımız için saniyede 5 fatura gönderim limiti uygulanırken, Profesyonel paket kullanıcılarımız saniyede 20 fatura gönderim kapasitesine sahip olmaktadır. API üzerinden yapılan toplu işlemlerde bu limitlerin aşılması durumunda sistem otomatik olarak kuyruğa alma yöntemine geçmektedir. Güncel limitlerinizi kullanıcı yetkileri panelinden kontrol edebilirsiniz.

evidence.title: Verileri Dışa Aktarma ve Format Seçenekleri
evidence.heading: İşlem Süreleri ve Veri Kapsamı
evidence.body: Dışa aktarma işlemini başlattığınızda, sistem verilerinizi hazırlayıp dosya haline getirerek 30 saniye içinde işlemi tamamlamış olur. Ancak, sistem performansını korumak amacıyla arşivlenmiş verilerle ilgili bir kısıtlama bulunmaktadır. 3 yıldan daha eski olan ve arşivlenmiş statüsündeki veriler, toplu dışa aktarım listelerine dahil edilemez ve bu veriler için farklı yöntemler izlenmelidir.

evidence.title: e-Fatura Gönderim Hızı ve Kota Politikası (Eski Sistem)
evidence.heading: Paket İçeriği ve İşlem Kapasitesi
evidence.body: Mevcut v1 politikasında, seçtiğiniz paketin sadece toplam fatura sayısı kotası geçerliydi. Gönderim hızı konusunda bir üst limit uygulanmadığı için, toplu veri aktarımlarında veya yüksek hacimli e-ticaret entegrasyonlarında herhangi bir gecikme yaşanmıyordu. Bu esnek yapı, özellikle yüksek işlem hacmine sahip büyük ölçekli işletmelerimiz için operasyonel kolaylık sağlıyordu.

evidence.title: e-Fatura Gönderim Hızı ve Paket Limitleri (Güncel Sistem)
evidence.heading: Yeni Nesil v2 Gönderim Limitleri
evidence.body: Sistem performansını optimize etmek amacıyla geçiş yaptığımız v2 altyapısında, gönderim hızı artık paket içeriğine göre belirlenmektedir. Eski v1 politikasındaki sınırsız gönderim uygulaması tamamen kaldırılmış olup, artık her paket için tanımlanmış olan saniyede gönderim limitleri geçerlidir. Bu sayede tüm kullanıcılarımıza daha stabil ve yüksek performanslı bir bulut deneyimi sunmayı hedefliyoruz.
